name: AutomationDirect T1H-EBC controller communications interface
aliases: AutomationDirect T1H-EBC controller communications interface GA
summary: T1H-EBC controller communications interface arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: T1H-EBC is the drawing identifier for controller communications interface in AutomationDirect's Terminator Field I/O collection. A controller communications interface connects the selected controller system to a specified information link. Cable connectors and their bend space are part of the equipment arrangement.

For example, in a control panel exchanging information with a supervisory network, use the T1H-EBC reference to coordinate network connectors, cable approach and interface replacement. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Other PLC Products/Terminator Field IO/T1H-EBC.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep network connectors, cable approach and interface replacement visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named T1H-EBC drawing and its controller communications interface role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
